guides.title: What's needed for a Telugu wedding
guides.text: By ceremony, families usually need: Mangala Snanam (haldi): haldi jewelry and haldi jalleda. Kanyadanam: a Kanyadanam set and a decorated coconut. Jeelakarra Bellam and the main ceremony: the couple's garland pair, basingalu, a sanapeeta, Ariveni pots, the Addu Thera curtain. Talambralu: Navaratna talambralu with a pair of talambrala basins. Also common: kobbari kudakalu, a camphor garland, pooja flowers and a pooja kit. Our wedding packages (Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) cover much of this in one order.

guides.title: Ordering wedding garlands
guides.text: Garlands are sold as a pair for the bride and groom, in standard or long. Dallas-made fresh garlands need about 5 days' notice; garlands imported from India need about 3 weeks. Custom flowers or colours are quoted by the team: take a request.
